card.name: Just before female or sex-specific terms
card.fires_on: The spot just before a female term, such as 'Fem' in 'Females', ' female' before gender or mice, or the comma before 'XY'. It also fires on a space or digit before a women's voting year.

modes.label: Female formula line
modes.description: The 'Fem' of 'Females:' starting the second line of a creatinine clearance formula after the male line.
modes.example: Males: Weight (kg) x (140 - age) 72 x serum creatinine (mg/100 mL)<< Fem>>ales: 0.85 x

modes.label: Female as a risk factor or animal group
modes.description: The word 'female' in lists of risk factors or animal sex groups.
modes.example: Predisposing factors include advanced age (≥65),<< female>> gender, uncontrolled hypothyroidism

modes.label: Male-female contrast
modes.description: A comma or number where a sex-linked term such as XY or a women's voting date comes next.
modes.example: 46, XX chromosomes and a male normally has 46<<,>> XY. Klinefelter's syndrome

card.writes: It suppresses sex and gender words such as male and gender, so it likely stops the model from repeating them right after.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to name a sex, mainly the 'Females' line after 'Males' in kidney formulas.
